title: Thai Chicken Stir Fry
description: A quick and flavorful dish made with chicken, Thai stir fry sauce, and a variety of vegetables. This recipe is easy to make and can be customized with your favorite ingredients.
instructions: Heat 1 tablespoon of vegetable oil in a large skillet or wok over medium-high heat.
Add the chicken to the skillet and cook until browned and cooked through, about 5-7 minutes.
Remove the chicken from the skillet and set aside.
Add the remaining 1 tablespoon of vegetable oil to the skillet.
Add the bell peppers, onions, and snow peas to the skillet and cook until the vegetables are tender, about 3-5 minutes.
Add the Thai stir fry sauce, soy sauce, sesame oil, ginger, and chili flakes to the skillet and stir to combine.
Return the chicken to the skillet and stir to combine with the sauce and vegetables.
Cook for an additional 1-2 minutes, until the sauce has thickened and the chicken is coated.
Serve hot over rice or noodles.
Garnish with sesame seeds and chopped green onions, if desired.
